It’s a localized computational failure in Node Three."

"It won't blow; it will *lock*—it locks Sector Two’s primary coolant loop into a self-replicating, non-functional state."

THE IMMEDIATE CRISIS

A systemic shock wave runs through the command level, even without the physical action. The gravity of her prediction settles over the room. A locked coolant loop means a cascading thermal failure that rapidly threatens every life support system in Sector Two—a far more insidious threat than a simple explosion.

"The quarantine holds it contained," Helena concludes, her gaze locking onto yours. "But pulling Riona means trading an external breach for total internal systems failure."

REN'S CONCERN

Ren, having listened to the precise technical exchange, nods slowly. The physical threat has been clarified, and her focus immediately shifts back to the intellectual solution. "If we cannot stabilize Sector Two with Riona," she murmurs, tapping at a waveform on the console. "Then the frequency purge needs to be precise enough to bypass the coolant dependency altogether. It has to hit Delta-9."

Authorize Ren to run the targeted frequency purge immediately. ```html
